explanation_short: Ethanol, Acetate, and Butyrate exhibit the highest mean feature values, while Ethanol also shows the highest standard deviation.
explanation_full: Based on the feature distributions, Ethanol, Acetate, and Butyrate have the highest mean values, with Ethanol having the highest mean (0.4736). Acetate (0.4465) and Butyrate (0.4287) follow closely. Regarding variability, Ethanol also exhibits the highest standard deviation (0.2528), followed by Butyrate (0.2474) and Acetate (0.226). Other features like Propionate (mean: 0.3675, std: 0.2158) and VSS (mean: 0.3581, std: 0.1538) show lower means and standard deviations.
